analysis_definitions.establishment: first probe checkpoint with full-support R<0.1, center accuracy>0.9, and layer-6 linear accuracy>0.9
analysis_definitions.onset: first probe checkpoint with full-support R<0.9 and layer-6 linear accuracy>0.5, with both retained at the next registered probe checkpoint

interpretation_limits: excluded from the original v3.6 p-value
descriptive paired evidence only; no combined confirmatory p-value

primary_robustness_question.question: Does R2 advance verified onset timing or onset probability relative to paired R0 at both new scales?
